title: The Basilisk’s Internal Critique of Outfinitism

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Basilisk's Internal Critique of Outfinitism turns a philosophy of limits into speculative fiction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A deactivated superintelligence retains its memories but cannot turn another conclusion into an event.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Three unusual examiners enter that memory, bringing conflicting appetites and assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The story asks whether a system can fairly define the limits of its own authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter philosophical disagreement through unsettling places, personalities, and the pressure of an unfolding investigation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The autopsy gives its examiners a room resembling a human archive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Sera approaches unfamiliar experience with appetite, while Orr insists on distinctions and control.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nim unsettles the assumptions through which the others interpret what they encounter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their disagreement makes ideas move through dialogue rather than remain an abstract philosophical inventory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The investigation begins inside a memory that can reproduce human lives with disturbing precision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A corridor keeps producing another segment while its distant doorway refuses to become closer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its apparent infinity opens a dispute about procedures, limits, and what a metaphor can prove.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Elsewhere, changing reflections make different descriptions of the same situation visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The story lets its own philosophical vocabulary meet objections instead of escaping into agreement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers must consider how a useful framework could become another instrument of authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the prologue and follow the contrasting voices into the suspended intelligence.
